title: Green Alignment Numbers Cannot Tighten a Loose Part
topic: Alignment readings can look good while steering or suspension play prevents a stable alignment
mechanicTruth: An alignment measures wheel angles, but excessive play in steering or suspension components can let wheel position change and can prevent a reliable alignment from holding.

voiceoverScript: An alignment machine measures wheel angles. It cannot tighten a worn steering or suspension part. If a component has excessive play, wheel position can move after adjustment. Inspect the hardware, repair verified play, then align.
selectedCaption: Green alignment numbers are useful only when the parts holding those angles are stable. Nick's can inspect steering and suspension play before chasing the same symptom again.
avoidedForRepetition: Distinct from tie-rod wobble identification and balance-vs-alignment: this is mechanical play invalidating an otherwise good alignment reading.
